response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, including work with geospatial data (GISCollective), low-latency systems (Dunnhumby), and distributed systems (Altom Consulting). However, his primary language is not C++ or Rust, and his recent work has focused on JavaScript/TypeScript rather than the required geospatial routing pipeline technologies. His geospatial work is promising but lacks clear evidence of routing-specific optimizations or production-scale geospatial data pipelines.
strengths: Strong background in geospatial data processing (GISCollective)
Experience with low-latency systems and distributed architectures (Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt across languages and domains
concerns: Limited direct experience with C++/Rust required for routing tile optimization
Lack of explicit experience with navigation systems or routing pipelines
Most recent work focuses on frontend/backend JavaScript rather than performance-critical systems
